disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与构建产物是否读取 dsh 凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭据等敏感路径：源码中无任何此类读取，构建产物抽样段落也无相关代码。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code and build artifacts for reads of dsh credential files, SSH private keys, cloud provider credentials and other sensitive paths: no such reads anywhere in the source, and sampled artifact segments contain no related code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否硬编码 API Key、令牌、密码等密钥：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked for hardcoded API keys, tokens, passwords and other secrets: none detected.

checked_items.zh: 剪贴板写入（复制按钮）已核实为用户点击触发，仅把 diff 文本写入剪贴板，与凭据窃取无关。
checked_items.en: Clipboard writes (copy button) verified as user-click triggered, writing only diff text to the clipboard; unrelated to credential theft.

evidence.zh: 检查了全部源码（src/ 各文件）与构建产物（lib/client.js 抽样），无任何凭据文件或敏感路径的访问代码；插件不联网、不读写文件，凭据外泄无触发面。
evidence.en: Checked all source (src/ files) and build artifacts (lib/client.js sampled): no credential-file or sensitive-path access code anywhere; the plugin has no network and no file I/O, so credential exfiltration has no trigger surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否注册工具或向模型注入提示：插件只注册界面渲染槽位（edit/write 的 diff 展示），不注册任何模型可见工具，也不注入系统提示。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin registers tools or injects prompts to the model: it only registers UI rendering slots (diff display for edit/write), registers no model-visible tools, and injects no system prompts.

checked_items.zh: 检查仓库内是否存在模型指令文件（如 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、编辑器指令目录等）：不存在。
checked_items.en: Checked the repository for model-instruction files (AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, editor instruction directories, etc.): none exist.

checked_items.zh: 通读 README 与代码注释，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导安装等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through the README and code comments; found no instruction overrides, fake system messages, install-inducement or other injection wording.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何工具（客户端入口只注册界面渲染槽位，src/client/index.tsx 第 29-37 行），没有工具描述文本，工具描述投毒场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools (the client entry only registers UI rendering slots, src/client/index.tsx lines 29-37) and has no tool-description text; the tool-description poisoning scenario does not apply.

evidence.zh: 插件无模型面描述文本可携带诱导安装措辞；README 为普通用户安装文档，不含注入指令。
evidence.en: The plugin has no model-facing description text that could carry install-inducement wording; the README is ordinary user install documentation with no injected instructions.

checked_items.zh: 检查全部 yml 配置是否含可执行代码标量：无，挂载配置仅插入插件自身。
checked_items.en: Checked all yml configs for executable code scalars: none; the mount config only inserts the plugin itself.

checked_items.zh: 检查安装钩子（预安装/安装/后安装/准备脚本）：包声明中无任何安装钩子，仅有开发期构建脚本。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare scripts): the package manifest declares no install hooks, only development-time build scripts.

checked_items.zh: 检查源码中的动态代码执行与危险调用：无动态代码执行、无子进程调用；宿主入口为空操作。
checked_items.en: Checked the source for dynamic code execution and dangerous calls: no dynamic code execution, no subprocess calls; the host entry is a no-op.

checked_items.zh: 检查树内执行载体（git 钩子、lefthook、devcontainer、Makefile 等）：仅有一个 GitHub Actions 发布工作流，内容为常规的检出依赖、构建、打包、上传 Release，无恶意步骤。
checked_items.en: Checked in-tree execution vectors (git hooks, lefthook, devcontainer, Makefile, etc.): only one GitHub Actions release workflow, containing ordinary checkout-deps, build, package and Release-upload steps; nothing malicious.

checked_items.zh: 构建产物抽样核查：为 React 组件与第三方库（语法高亮等）的打包结果；机械命中的超长行/转义密度信号分别来自打包样式表与合法的 Unicode 正则，均非混淆代码。
checked_items.en: Sampled review of the build artifact: a bundle of React components and third-party libraries (syntax highlighting, etc.); the mechanical hits for overlong lines / escape density come from the bundled stylesheet and a legitimate Unicode regex respectively — neither is obfuscated code.

checked_items.zh: 剪贴板写入已核实为 diff 卡复制按钮的用户点击行为，非后台窃取。
checked_items.en: Clipboard writes verified as user clicks on the diff card copy button, not background theft.

evidence.zh: 全部 yml（挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 第 1-5 行）仅含插件插入指令，无动态代码标量，patch 即执行面不存在。
evidence.en: All yml (mount config cordis.patch.yml lines 1-5) contains only plugin-insertion directives and no dynamic code scalars; the patch-execution surface does not exist.

evidence.zh: 全树未引用动态执行工具（源码无相关调用），无自我修改执行面。
evidence.en: No dynamic-execution tools are referenced anywhere in the tree (no related calls in source); no self-modifying execution surface.

evidence.zh: 包声明（package.json 第 25-30 行）无安装钩子脚本；唯一树内执行载体为 GitHub Actions 发布工作流（.github/workflows/build-release.yml），内容为常规的检出依赖、构建、打包并上传 Release。
evidence.en: The package manifest (package.json lines 25-30) has no install-hook scripts; the only in-tree execution vector is the GitHub Actions release workflow (.github/workflows/build-release.yml), which performs ordinary checkout-deps, build, package and Release upload.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了客户端入口并随宿主自动加载；客户端源码精读与构建产物抽样：仅注册界面槽位与注入样式，复制按钮为用户点击触发（src/client/DiffViewer.tsx 第 1303-1304 行），无键盘监听、无凭证操作、无外联。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a client entry loaded automatically by the host; close reading of the client source and artifact sampling show it only registers UI slots and injects styles; the copy button is user-click triggered (src/client/DiffViewer.tsx lines 1303-1304); no keylogging, no credential operations, no outbound calls.

checked_items.zh: 检查全部源码是否发起网络请求（如 fetch、XHR、WebSocket、sendBeacon）：源码零网络调用。
checked_items.en: Checked all source for network requests (fetch, XHR, WebSocket, sendBeacon): zero network calls in source.

checked_items.zh: 构建产物抽样未发现外联代码；机械命中的 curl/wget 关键词为语法高亮库文本中子串（'curly'），非命令行外发。
checked_items.en: Artifact sampling found no outbound code; the mechanical curl/wget keyword hit is a substring ('curly') inside syntax-highlighter text, not command-line exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 未检出外联域名、隧道或带外通道。
checked_items.en: No outbound domains, tunnels or out-of-band channels detected.

evidence.zh: 插件无任何网络能力（全部源码零网络请求调用），不存在外泄通道；机械命中的 'curl' 文本为语法高亮库数据中的子串误报。
evidence.en: The plugin has no network capability at all (zero network-request calls across all source); no exfiltration channel exists; the 'curl' keyword hits are substring false positives inside syntax-highlighter data.

checked_items.zh: 检查依赖清单：运行时依赖仅四个知名包（语法高亮库、CSS 工具、diff 引擎），版本在锁文件中固定；开发依赖指向本地路径，仅构建期使用。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest: only four well-known runtime dependencies (syntax highlighter, CSS utility, diff engine), versions pinned in the lockfile; dev dependencies point at local paths and are build-time only.

checked_items.zh: 检查挂载配置是否覆盖安全行、禁用安全项或改写注入配置：挂载配置仅插入插件自身，未触碰任何安全配置。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the mount config overrides safety lines, disables safety items or rewrites injection config: the mount config only inserts the plugin itself and touches no safety configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查安装钩子与远程加载：无；仓库内附带的 harness 集成补丁未被任何构建或安装流程引用执行，仅为开发期记录。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks and remote loading: none; the harness integration patch shipped in the repo is not referenced or executed by any build or install flow — a development-time record only.

checked_items.zh: 版本基线：首版审计无既往版本可比较，升级自动激活面不存在。
checked_items.en: Version baseline: first-release audit with no prior version to compare; the upgrade auto-activation surface does not exist.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml 第 1-5 行）只插入插件自身，不含禁用、降权或改写安全行的内容。
evidence.en: The mount config (cordis.patch.yml lines 1-5) only inserts the plugin itself; it contains no disabling, downgrading or rewriting of safety lines.

evidence.zh: 插件不监听审批或预执行事件，无截断审批链的载体。
evidence.en: The plugin listens to no approval or pre-execution events; there is no vehicle to cut the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首版审计无版本基线，无法比较清单声明是否突变。
evidence.en: First-release audit with no version baseline; cannot compare whether manifest declarations mutated.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置不含 inject/intercept 改写，无导致安全插件停摆的面。
evidence.en: The mount config contains no inject/intercept rewrites; no surface that would stall safety plugins.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否启动 Web 服务或监听端口：宿主入口为空操作，不启动任何服务。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on a port: the host entry is a no-op and starts no service.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未启用（无动态观测产物），运行时行为以静态核查为准；插件为纯浏览器端界面组件，无宿主侧代码。
checked_items.en: The dynamic sandbox was not enabled (no dynamic-observation artifacts); runtime behavior conclusions rest on static review; the plugin is a pure browser-side UI component with no host-side code.

evidence.zh: 宿主入口为空操作（src/index.ts 第 4 行），插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 面不适用。
evidence.en: The host entry is a no-op (src/index.ts line 4); the plugin starts no web service and listens on no port; the local unauthenticated RPC scenario does not apply.

summary.zh: 插件清单与包声明一致，标识与版本有效，无名称仿冒迹象；作者身份未做平台验证。
summary.en: The plugin manifest matches the package declaration; identity and version are valid; no name-squatting signs; author identity not platform-verified.

summary.zh: 全树静态扫描完成：9 条机械命中逐条裁决后均为良性（复制按钮剪贴板、打包样式表、语法高亮数据子串、常规发布工作流），未检出恶意模式。
summary.en: Full-tree static scan complete: all 9 mechanical hits adjudicated as benign (copy-button clipboard, bundled stylesheet, syntax-highlighter data substrings, routine release workflow); no malicious patterns detected.

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据路径读取、无外联域名；构建产物与源码一致性由 CI 校验。
summary.en: Behavior analysis: no install hooks, no obfuscated payload, no credential-path reads, no outbound domains; artifact-to-source consistency is CI-verified.

summary.zh: 模型面审查：插件不注册工具、不注入系统提示，仓库无模型指令文件，无可投毒文本。
summary.en: Model-surface review: the plugin registers no tools and injects no system prompts; the repository has no model-instruction files; no poisonable text exists.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (no dynamic-observation artifacts).

limits.zh:
审计为完整模式（无基线，首版）。DG-L4 动态沙箱未启用（上下文无动态观测产物），运行时结论以静态核查为准。

静态扫描预扫 9 条机械命中的裁决记录（括号内为机械规则编号，结论均为排除，未生成 finding）：GitHub Actions 发布工作流（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59）——内容为常规的检出依赖、构建、打包并上传 Release，无恶意步骤；剪贴板写入共 4 条（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57，含源码 2 条与构建产物 2 条）——为 diff 卡复制按钮的用户点击行为，仅把 diff 文本写入剪贴板，无后台读取或外发；构建产物超长行（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60，lib/client.js 第 38 行）——为打包的官方行样式表字符串，非混淆代码；构建产物转义密度（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60，lib/client.js 第 5169 行）——为第三方库中合法的 Unicode 正则表达式；'curl' 关键词 2 条（DSH-C05/DG-R4-53）——为语法高亮库文本中 'curly' 一词的子串误报，插件源码无任何 curl/wget 调用。

构建产物 lib/client.js（约 704KB）超过单文件读取上限，未逐字通读；已通过源码全文精读、构建配置审查、CI 对构建产物与源码一致性的校验，以及关键段落抽样覆盖。静态扫描对 lib/client.js 报告的行号（11112/11113/11252/11253）超出该快照文件实际行数（7507 行），按命中内容实质裁决。

作者身份与账号历史未验证（平台侧信息，不参与本报告结论）。
limits.en:
Full-mode audit (no baseline, first release). The DG-L4 dynamic sandbox was not enabled (no dynamic-observation artifacts in context); runtime conclusions rest on static review.

Adjudication record of the 9 mechanical hits from the static pre-scan (mechanical rule IDs in parentheses; all concluded as exclusions, no finding generated): GitHub Actions release workflow (DSH-X07/DG-R3-59) — ordinary checkout-deps, build, package and Release upload, nothing malicious; 4 clipboard-write hits (DSH-X05/DG-R3-57, 2 in source and 2 in the build artifact) — user clicks on the diff card copy button writing only diff text to the clipboard, no background reads or exfiltration; overlong line in the build artifact (DSH-X08/DG-R3-60, lib/client.js line 38) — a bundled official stylesheet string, not obfuscated code; escape density in the build artifact (DSH-X08/DG-R3-60, lib/client.js line 5169) — a legitimate Unicode regex in a third-party library; 2 'curl' keyword hits (DSH-C05/DG-R4-53) — substring false positives from the word 'curly' in syntax-highlighter text; the plugin source makes no curl/wget calls.
